title.zh: 两栖动物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Amphibia to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开两栖动物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Amphibia time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的两栖动物时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Gerobatrachus hottoni and Triadobatrachus massinoti through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较二叠纪蛙螈干群与三叠纪无尾类干群；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: Gerobatrachus 克利尔福克正模窗口

description.en: Open the 283.3–274.4 Ma Clear Fork window to inspect sampled map context beside the sole Gerobatrachus hottoni holotype, USNM 489135, and the source-linked matrix result.
description.zh: 打开 283.3–274.4 Ma 的克利尔福克窗口，结合唯一的 Gerobatrachus hottoni 正模标本 USNM 489135 及其关联的性状矩阵结果，检查采样地图背景。

limitations: USNM 489135 from the Clear Fork Group in Baylor County, Texas is one articulated specimen; the 279 Ma map age is a rounded Kungurian-window selector, not a direct specimen date or a global range. The stem-batrachian result is model-dependent, and sampled markers do not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, behaviour, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration. / 得州贝勒县克利尔福克群的 USNM 489135 是一件关节相连的标本；279 Ma 地图年龄是舍入后的 Kungur期窗口选择值，并非标本直接定年或全球延限。蛙螈干群结果依赖性状矩阵模型，采样标记不能证明完整分布、直系祖先、行为或化石与地图的精确共定位。

title.zh: Triadobatrachus 萨卡梅纳 μCT 窗口

description.en: Open the 251.902–247 Ma Middle Sakamena-equivalent window near Betsiaka to inspect the sampled context for the unique split-nodule holotype MNHN.F.MAE.126 and its μCT anatomy.
description.zh: 打开贝齐亚卡附近 251.902–247 Ma 的中萨卡梅纳等效地层窗口，检查唯一分裂结核正模标本 MNHN.F.MAE.126 及其 μCT 解剖证据的采样背景。

limitations: MNHN.F.MAE.126 is one damaged part-and-counterpart specimen from Middle Sakamena-equivalent beds near Betsiaka, Madagascar; 249 Ma is a rounded stage-scale map age, not a directly dated skeleton. μCT observations and the stem-salientian character interpretation remain separate from a complete distribution, specialized-jumping behaviour, direct ancestry, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration. / 马达加斯加贝齐亚卡附近中萨卡梅纳等效地层的 MNHN.F.MAE.126 是一件受损的正负模标本；249 Ma 是舍入后的阶级时间地图年龄，并非骨架的直接定年。μCT 观察与无尾类干群性状解释不能证明完整分布、特化跳跃行为、直系祖先或化石与地图的精确共定位。

description.en: Open the U–Pb-bracketed 223.036–218.043 Ma Thunderstorm Ridge window to inspect the upper Blue Mesa Member bonebed sample of at least 76 Funcusvermis individuals.
description.zh: 打开经 U–Pb 年代限定的 223.036–218.043 Ma 雷暴岭窗口，检查上蓝梅萨段骨床中至少 76 个 Funcusvermis 个体的样本。

limitations: The upper Blue Mesa Member of the Chinle Formation at Thunderstorm Ridge, Arizona preserves isolated three-dimensional elements from at least 76 individuals, not one articulated animal; 220 Ma is a rounded Norian map age within the U–Pb bracket. Total-group placement is a phylogenetic-model result, while sampled markers do not establish crown Gymnophiona, global distribution, fossorial behaviour, direct ancestry, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration. / 亚利桑那州雷暴岭钦勒组上蓝梅萨段保存的是至少 76 个个体的孤立三维骨骼元素，并非一具关节相连的动物；220 Ma 是 U–Pb 年代范围内舍入后的诺利期地图年龄。总群归属是系统发育模型结果，采样标记不能证明现生无足目冠群、全球分布、掘穴行为、直系祖先或化石与地图的精确共定位。

title.zh: Beiyanerpeton 髫髻山锆石约束窗口

description.en: Open the 160–154 Ma Tiaojishan Formation window at Hengdaozi to inspect sampled context for holotype PKUP V0601 and referred specimens PKUP V0602–V0606.
description.zh: 打开横道子 160–154 Ma 的髫髻山组窗口，检查正模标本 PKUP V0601 及被归入标本 PKUP V0602–V0606 的采样背景。

limitations: PKUP V0601–V0606 are six articulated specimens from the Tiaojishan Formation at Hengdaozi, western Liaoning; 157 Ma is a rounded map age within the formation envelope, while the 157 ± 3 Ma zircon date comes from overlying trachyandesite rather than a skeleton. Neoteny and salamandroid placement are specimen- and model-dependent interpretations, and sampled markers do not establish global distribution, behaviour, direct ancestry, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration. / 辽宁西部横道子髫髻山组的 PKUP V0601–V0606 是六件关节相连的标本；157 Ma 是地层范围内舍入后的地图年龄，而 157 ± 3 Ma 锆石年龄来自覆盖其上的粗面安山岩，并非骨架本身。幼态延续和蝾螈总科归属是依赖标本与模型的解释，采样标记不能证明全球分布、行为、直系祖先或化石与地图的精确共定位。
